title: Quietly Quenched Canadian Tofu Noodles
description: A post-workout Canadian dish featuring palm sugar, nam tan pip, and soffritto base, made with plant-based friendly ingredients to provide a boost of umami flavor and bouncy qq texture. This dish is perfect for a quick and satisfying dinner after a long day.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the soffritto base to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a small bowl, whisk together the palm sugar, nam tan pip, and vegetable broth.
Pour the sugar and broth mixture over the tofu and soffritto base in the skillet.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the noodles are well coated.
Transfer the noodles to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
